title: Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head for Tiny Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.29813v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-time onboard robot control calls for a lightweight vision-language-action (VLA) model, yet shrinking the backbone leaves less capacity for deliberation at inference time. Chain-of-thought decoding, dual-system architectures, and larger backbones can restore deliberation but reintroduce the latency and memory costs that motivated going small. Recurrent action heads offer a lighter alternative by iterating in latent space before committing to an action, but existing designs refine a single undifferentiated state that must simultaneously encode slowly evolving task context and rapidly changing motor commands. translated_title: 面向微型视觉-语言-动作模型的分层推理动作头
translated_abstract: 实时机载机器人控制需要轻量级的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，然而缩小骨干网络的规模会削弱模型在推理阶段进行深思推理的能力。思维链解码、双系统架构以及更大的骨干网络虽然可以恢复这种推理能力，但会重新引入当初促使模型小型化所要避免的延迟和内存开销。循环动作头通过在最终输出动作之前于潜空间中进行迭代，提供了一种更轻量的替代方案，但现有设计精炼的是单一无差别的潜状态，该状态必须同时编码缓慢演进的任务上下文和快速变化的运动指令。我们提出了分层推理动作头，它维护两个以不同频率更新的潜状态：低层状态快速更新，基于动作标记和本体感觉信息；高层状态缓慢更新，基于视觉理解以及融合了指令信息的低层状态。
tldr: 该论文提出分层推理动作头（HR-AH），通过维护两个以不同频率更新的潜状态——基于动作标记和本体感觉的快速低层状态、基于视觉理解的高层慢速状态——使微型VLA模型在保持轻量化的同时保留深思推理能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head (HR-AH), which maintains two latent states updated at different frequencies—a fast low-level state grounded in action tokens and proprioception, and a slow high-level state grounded in visual understanding—enabling tiny VLA models to retain deliberative reasoning capacity while staying lightweight.
